metadata.description: Fabric workspace GUID for Fabric IQ Data Agent connection (optional for Bicep flow).
Fabric Data Agent GUID for Fabric IQ Data Agent connection (optional for Bicep flow).
Optional full Fabric Data Agent MCP endpoint URL for Fabric IQ connection. If empty, Bicep uses the global api.fabric.microsoft.com endpoint.
Work IQ connection target URL for Maintenance and Plant Manager agents. Obtain from your M365 Work IQ service endpoint. Leave empty to skip.

properties.arguments: [format('-WorkspaceName {0} -EventhouseName {1} -KqlDatabaseName {2} -EventstreamName {3} -DataAgentName {4} -OntologyName {5} -QuerysetName {6} -DashboardName {7}', variables('workspaceName'), variables('eventhouseName'), variables('kqlDatabaseName'), variables('eventstreamName'), variables('dataAgentName'), variables('ontologyName'), variables('querysetName'), variables('dashboardName'))]
